Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents an item for sale in the cricket store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit for the product.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the product, if applicable.

handPreference.description: The preferred hand for the product, if applicable (e.g., for gloves).

miscellaneousCost.description: Miscellaneous costs like transportation, handling etc.

profitAmount.description: Profit margin as a fixed amount.

sellingPrice.description: Calculated selling price of the product.

finalPrice.description: An optional manual override for the selling price. If set, this price is used in sales.

hsnCode.description: HSN (Harmonized System Nomenclature) code for the product.

gstRate.description: GST (Goods and Services Tax) rate for the product.

isBundle.description: Indicates if the product is a bundle.

bundleItems.description: Array of sub-product IDs and quantities if the product is a bundle.

isActive.description: Indicates if the product is active.

locationComment.description: Comment on the location of the product.

priceHistory.description: An array of price change records for the product.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents an inventory item with its stock level, denormalized from Product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inventory item.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit for the product.

miscellaneousCost.description: Miscellaneous costs like transportation, handling etc.

sellingPrice.description: Calculated selling price of the product.

finalPrice.description: An optional manual override for the selling price.

hsnCode.description: HSN (Harmonized System Nomenclature) code for the product.

gstRate.description: GST (Goods and Services Tax) rate for the product.

isBundle.description: Indicates if the product is a bundle.

bundleItems.description: Array of sub-product IDs and quantities if the product is a bundle.

isActive.description: Indicates if the product is active.

locationComment.description: Comment on the location of the product.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item in stock.

lastStockUpdate.description: Date and time of the last stock update.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

title.description: Title of the customer (e.g., Mr., Ms.).

gstNumber.description: GST (Goods and Services Tax) number of the customer.

referenceName.description: Name of the person who referred the customer.

referenceContact.description: Contact number of the person who referred the customer.

purpose.description: The customer's purpose for their visit or registration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vendor.

gstNumber.description: GST (Goods and Services Tax) number of the vendor.

products.description: Array of product IDs supplied by the vendor.

PurchaseOrder.title: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Represents a purchase order placed with a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order.

orderDate.description: Date when the order was placed.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date for the order.

items.description: Array of product IDs, quantities, and prices in the order.

totalAmount.description: Total amount of the purchase order.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status of the purchase order.

SaleItem.title: SaleItem
SaleItem.description: Represents an item within a sale.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sale.

warrantyExpiryDate.description: Date the warranty for the sale expires.

items.description: Array of products sold with price details.

invoiceSequence.description: Invoice sequence number of the sale.

SalesReturn.title: SalesReturn
SalesReturn.description: Represents a returned item from a sale.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sales return.

condition.description: Condition of the returned item ('Sellable' or 'Non-Sellable').

refundAmount.description: Refund amount for the returned item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the expense.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company for this expense.

id.description: Unique identifier for the expense category.

hsnCode.description: Default HSN code for this category.

gstRate.description: Default GST rate for this category.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coupon.

minPurchaseAmount.description: Minimum purchase amount required to use the coupon.

validFrom.description: Date from which the coupon is valid.

validUntil.description: Date until which the coupon is valid.

isActive.description: Indicates if the coupon is active.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the coupon was created.

timesUsed.description: Number of times the coupon has been used.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be used.

id.description: Unique identifier for the support ticket.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the support ticket was created.

categoryId.description: Category ID for the support ticket

subCategoryId.description: Sub-Category ID for the support ticket

vendorId.description: Vendor ID for the support ticket

TicketMessage.title: TicketMessage
TicketMessage.description: Represents a message within a support ticket.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ticket message.

senderId.description: Unique identifier of the message sender.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the message was created.

Repair.title: Repair
Repair.description: Represents a repair job for a customer's product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the repair job.

issueDescription.description: A detailed description of the issue.

status.description: Current status of the repair (e.g., 'Pending', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Cancelled').

estimatedCost.description: The estimated cost for the repair.

actualCost.description: The final cost of the repair.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the repair job was created.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the repair job was completed.

EnquiryFollowUp.title: EnquiryFollowUp
EnquiryFollowUp.description: Represents a follow-up action on a customer enquiry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the follow-up.

Enquiry.title: Enquiry
Enquiry.description: Represents a customer enquiry or lead.

id.description: Unique identifier for the enquiry.

storeId.description: Reference to the store where the enquiry was made.

date.description: Timestamp when the enquiry was created.

enquiry.description: The details of the customer's enquiry.

convertedToId.description: Reference to the Sale or Quotation if converted (e.g., 'sale_123', 'quotation_456').

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application who has authenticated through Firebase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user, corresponding to Firebase UID.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile photo.

emailVerified.description: Indicates if the user's email address has been verified.

isApproved.description: Indicates if the user's account has been approved by an administrator.

role.description: The role of the user, which determines their access level.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created in Firebase.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a calendar event for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the event.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns the event.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

startTime.description: The start time of the event.

endTime.description: The end time of the event.

isAllDay.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the event was last updated.

Store.title: Store
Store.description: Represents a store in the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the store.

ownerId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Store). The id of the user that owns the store

id.description: Unique identifier for the warranty.

name.description: Display name of the warranty (e.g., '1 Year').

duration.description: Duration string used for date calculations (e.g., '1y', '6m').

HandPreference.title: HandPreference
HandPreference.description: Defines a hand preference for a product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the hand preference.

EnquiryStatus.title: EnquiryStatus
EnquiryStatus.description: Defines a status for an enquiry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the enquiry status.

CustomerType.title: CustomerType
CustomerType.description: Defines a type for a customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer type.

VendorType.title: VendorType
VendorType.description: Defines a type for a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vendor type.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Represents a log of user activity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the log entry.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action.

username.description: The name of the user at the time of the action.

timestamp.description: The date and time of the action.

action.description: A description of the action performed (e.g., 'Created Sale #INV-123').

ipAddress.description: The IP address from which the action was performed.

details.description: Optional object for storing additional context about the action.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed for the Cricket Store Manager application, prioritizing security, scalability, and ease of debugging, according to the core design principles. The primary strategy is Authorization Independence achieved via denormalization. Each document includes the necessary authorization context to avoid `get()` calls in security rules.

The `users/{userId}` collection stores user profiles, with the `userId` derived from Firebase Authentication's `uid`. User-owned data is stored under hierarchical paths like `/users/{userId}/stores/{storeId}`, reflecting the User 1:N Store relationship. This makes ownership clear and simplifies security rules. The `Store` documents contain an `ownerId` field, which is also used to establish the ownership relationship.

For entities related to a `Store`, such as `Product`, `Vendor`, `Customer`, etc., the structure uses collections like `/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}`.  Authorization independence is maintained by including `storeId` in each of these documents, avoiding the need to query the parent `Store` document to determine access rights.  This enables atomic operations and easier debugging.  The `InventoryItem` is also stored under `/stores/{storeId}`, with a denormalized structure containing all fields of the associated `Product` to enable efficient querying and display of inventory data without requiring joins.

The `Sale` document includes `customerId` and `customerName`. Similar to above, this enables Authorization Independence within Sales collection.

This structure supports the QAPs requirement by structurally segregating data based on access needs. Private user data resides under `/users/{userId}`, while store-specific data resides under `/stores/{storeId}`. Security rules can then be applied at the collection level based on these paths.
